tags.description: Check whether a specific IP address is part of the ​Akamai​ edge network.
tags.name: IP verification

post.description: Verifies if an IP belongs to an edge server. For IPs verified positively, you can continue gathering diagnostic data with [Request content with cURL](ref:post-curl), [Get domain details with dig](ref:post-dig), or [Test network connectivity with MTR](ref:post-mtr) operations. You can enter up to 10 IPs.
